question: what is the smallest detectable jump SD given the fittable player count and the Phase 3b reliability, and is the locked 50 ms SOI detectable?

locked_soi.reading: 50 ms is 49.8% of the 0.1004 s between-player SD, i.e. 24.8% of between-player variance. The share is squared; comparing an SD ratio to a variance-share floor would overstate power.

estimator.floor: z*sqrt(2/P_eff): normal approximation to the sampling SD of a between-player variance share
estimator.p_eff: Kish (sum r)^2/sum r^2 over fittable players' three-level reliabilities
estimator.why: This is the design floor already used by Phase 1(i) and Phase 3b, extended with the share-to-SD inversion. It is a design approximation, not a posterior width; the Phase 4 fit is the confirmation.

answers.verdict: 50 ms is not detectable at any candidate cut, nor with every fittable player. The smallest detectable jump SD is 54.4 ms at the 20-rep cut and 51.8 ms with all 123 fittable players. It would become detectable at P_eff >= 125 (about 125 fittable players at the cut-20 reliability mix). The release supplies at most 123 fittable players, so the locked SOI is outside what this design can resolve.

caveats: The reliability evidence is measured on the published player_get_off mean, an upper bound on the reliability of the residual jump (0.869 at 25% of between-player variance removed, 0.815 at 50%). The table is therefore a best case.

The locked outcome is the tracked LOS crossing, which carries the integer-yard spot error (about 0.29 yd, 0.14 s). That noise is not in the reliability evidence; it can only raise the smallest detectable SD.
The floor is a design approximation, not a model-based power simulation. Phase 4's posterior intervals are the confirmation.

The Kish count weights players by relative reliability only; a cruder P * mean-reliability attenuation gives a slightly larger smallest detectable SD at every cut. The verdict — no candidate cut resolves 50 ms — is unchanged.
No number here is UNVALIDATED SAMPLE OUTPUT: every input is a complete label-file artefact (Phase 3b, provenance FULL). The 0.86 yd plane offset does not enter this calculation.

inputs.reliability_estimator: three-level nested ANOVA (reps in games in players), method of moments
